label: D2 after a rewarded previous trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (all of its activation mass), and almost only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 99.9% of the mass; it is essentially silent at D2 after an unrewarded trial). It also depends strongly on how far into the episode the agent is: the rate is highest in trials 0-39, falls through 40-69 and is zero after about trial 70, so it is an early-episode unit (probably tracking slow drift in the hidden state). D2 & prev_reward==1 alone gets recall 1.0 but precision 0.23; adding ep_trial<50 brings dev precision to 0.46, recall 0.95, F1 0.62, mass recall 0.96. Magnitude: biggest when the state reached is S2 (70% of the mass, mostly a2 -> S2 common), larger when the value estimate is high (75% of mass in the top value bin), and somewhat larger after streaks of rewards (requiring the trial two back also rewarded gives F1 0.67). Common vs rare on the current trial changes it little. It never fires at D1 or GO. All variables are observed (ep_trial is a time index the agent can only track implicitly), and no future variables are used.
